rules: A local media brand with Eric at the center. The feed remains useful before someone needs to buy or sell.

Use After Hours consistently, with the recommended daytime warm base.
Use source-supported towns, streets, businesses, homes and Glastonbury/East of the River locations as visual identity.

typeTreatments.role: Strong hook words and compact support

composition: Split approved copy into editable phrase layers. Use scale and font contrast to rank the words. Four treatments are available; each cover need not use all four.
Keep the adopted After Hours palette. Amber carries keyword emphasis. Paper carries readable support. Reference colors do not expand the brand palette.
Remove decorative white outlines and outlined boxes. Keep contrast in the photo or a soft fade. No mandatory headline card.
Reduce excess headroom and place Eric higher in the frame. Keep his face clear and the real location recognizable.
For depth, duplicate the same approved image and use native Figma Remove background on the foreground copy. Preserve the source pixel scale and placement when trimming the cutout bounds.
Stack the background photo, optional rear type, unchanged-person cutout, then foreground type. A small keyword overlap may cross the crown or shoulder; it must remain readable.
Do not regenerate or retouch Eric, his face, body or clothes. Do not copy reference towns, property facts or headlines into client covers.
Compose Grid and Reel separately. Keep important text inside the frame and inspect both at phone scale.

editableBounds.authority: Jerami correction on 2026-10-13: selectable image and text bounds must be tight for easy Figma editing.
editableBounds.cutouts: Crop the foreground rectangle to its actual nontransparent subject bounds, intersected with the cover bounds. Preserve image scale and source alignment through the image crop transform. Do not retain a full-photo transparent hit box.
editableBounds.text: Use separate phrase layers with Auto width or Auto height. Keep text boxes close to the rendered phrase; no full-cover text hit areas or empty oversized wrappers.
editableBounds.locking: Lock background photos, foreground cutouts and decorative fades after composition. Keep every text phrase unlocked for direct selection. Unlock a named image layer only when its crop needs editing.
editableBounds.readback: Check alpha bounds, crop transform, cover containment and unlocked text layers before review. Inspect that clicking type is not intercepted by a large transparent image rectangle.
